parameters.formDescription: Run Setup. Choose what to run, on which languages and tasks, and which configured provider node answers for each LLM role.

values.html:
1. What is being run

The run mode fixes which pipeline executes. Components of that pipeline are enabled or ablated on the last screen.

2. Tasks

Every selected language needs at least one task. The names are the task contracts under benchmark/tasks/<language>/task_contracts; the run queue is one run per selected language and task. Selections for a language you did not select are ignored.

3. LLM roles

This form selects only which configured provider node each role uses. The exact model and the n8n credential stay in the built-in selector of the matching OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini Chat Model node on the canvas. A role the selected run mode and ablation cannot reach is never resolved, so it does not need a configured model.

values.html:
Semantic test generation

The strategy selects the prompting variant workflow for the chosen provider, matched on its exact strategy suffix.

options.formDescription: How semantic tests are generated. The validated-test lifecycle is generate → extract → technical validation → reference validation; those components are standard, and are turned off only as an explicit ablation on the last screen. Ignored when the run mode is Transformations Only.

values.html:
Transformation generation

Configured independently of semantic tests: the two branches carry their own provider and their own prompting strategy.

options.formDescription: How transformations are generated. The lifecycle is generate → syntax validation, followed by parser-feedback refinement when a generated transformation does not parse. Ignored when the run mode is Semantic Tests Only.

values.html:
Refinement

The upper bound on refinement iterations per run, for both branches. Zero disables refinement without ablating any component.

Experiment configuration

Pick a named profile, or Custom ablation and then the exact components to disable below. A named profile with components selected is refused rather than silently applied.

options.formDescription: RQ4 configuration. A standard run ablates nothing. The named profiles are the variants under experiments/variants/; custom ablation disables individual components. Whatever is disabled is named in the run's pipeline_variant.
